texto.@es: El pasado de **am/is** es **was**; el de **are** es **were**: **I was**, **you were**, **they were**.
texto.@en: **am/is**'s past is **was**; **are**'s past is **were**: **I was**, **you were**, **they were**.

texto.@es: Para negar, añade **not**: **I wasn't** (no estaba) y **they weren't** (no estaban).
texto.@en: To deny, add **not**: **I wasn't** (not present) and **they weren't** (not present).

texto.@es: En pregunta, **was/were** va antes del sujeto: **Was the hotel...?**, **Were you...?**
texto.@en: In question, **was/were** goes before the subject: **Was the hotel...?**, **Were you...?**

texto.@es: **The hotel was near the station last night.** = El hotel estaba cerca de la estación anoche.
texto.@en: **The hotel was near the station last night.** = The hotel was near the station last night.

opciones.texto: They were at the station last night.
They was at the station last night.

explicacion.@es: «Was» va con I, he, she o it.
explicacion.@en: «Was» goes with I, he, she or it.

opciones.texto: They are at the station last night.

explicacion.@es: «Last night» sitúa la frase en el pasado.
explicacion.@en: «Last night» places the phrase in the past.

bloques.frase: The hotel ___ near the station last night.

explicacion.@es: Esta forma va con you o sujetos plurales.
explicacion.@en: This form goes with you or plural subjects.

explicacion.@es: El pasado de «to be» no usa «did».
explicacion.@en: The past of «to be» does not use «did».

bloques.frase: We weren't at the hotel last night.

opciones.texto: No estuvimos en el hotel anoche.

explicacion.@es: «Weren't» es la forma negativa pasada de «were».
explicacion.@en: «Weren't» is the past negative form of «were».

opciones.texto: No estuvimos en la estación anoche.

explicacion.@es: «At the hotel» significa en el hotel.
explicacion.@en: «At the hotel» means at the hotel.

bloques.frase: Were you at the hotel last night

traduccion.@en: You were at the hotel last night?

pregunta.@es: Escribe en inglés: «Estaban cerca del hotel anoche.»
pregunta.@en: Write in English: «They were close to the hotel last night.»

respuestas: They were near the hotel last night.

intro.@es: Practica usar «was» y «were» en pasado con ejemplos de afirmación, negación y pregunta.
intro.@en: Practice using «was» and «were» in the past with examples of affirmation, denial and question.
